tour.welcome.title: Welcome to ReduxShare!
tour.welcome.text: A demo Moodle page with real questions. The network is mocked — nobody sees your clicks. A short tour shows what the extension can do.
tour.rWidget.title: The R button next to every answer
tour.rWidget.text: Every answer option has an R button that opens the menu with all known answers. The R hotkey is set in the popup.
tour.menu.title: Answer menu
tour.menu.text: Internal shows the exact answer and statistics, External — answers from the external database, AI — a neural network request. Click an option to fill it in.
tour.stats.title: Statistics and voting
tour.stats.text: Statistics lists every option from other users with 👍/👎 votes. Dubious answers are marked amber. Vote to make the database sharper.
tour.ai.title: AI assistant
tour.ai.text: Send request solves the question, Explain answer shows the solution. Click to apply the answer. The provider key is set in the popup AI tab.
tour.essay.title: Essays: community examples
tour.essay.text: Essays show the best example answers — insert and edit them. Save your own as an example and vote for the ones you like.
tour.autoSelect.title: Auto-fill and humanization
tour.autoSelect.text: Answers are selected by themselves — with adjustable tempo and humanization: reading, delays, click order.
tour.statusPanel.title: Attempt status panel
tour.statusPanel.text: The panel shows progress and time. The settings tray holds copy unlock and auto-pass with a pause on hard questions.
tour.preview.title: Question preview
tour.preview.text: Before the attempt a popup opens with every question and answer — from the shared database or an external source (with an ID scan).
tour.import.title: Import after submission
tour.import.text: After you submit a quiz, the answers from the review page are imported into the shared database — even if you pressed nothing. The popup shows how many questions you contributed.
tour.popup.title: Extension popup
tour.popup.text: The extension icon opens the popup: sign-in, stats, auto-fill, appearance, security, AI and servers.
tour.finish.title: All done!
tour.finish.text: That's all. On a real Moodle page it works the same — open any quiz.
tour.finished.title: Tour finished!
tour.finished.text: Now you know how it works on Moodle.
